title: Notes from Not Plain
quote:
My mom murdered my dad. She became eligible for parole last year. 

I couldn’t deal with the potential of her being released before I had looked into what ACTUALLY happened that night so I ordered the case files and dove into my nightmare. 

I’m sharing his story, my story, to honor my dad. For too long he suffered in silence. He deserved a voice. He deserved to live.
